records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Glad to have Lantern Partners on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Next step with your Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Hope the first project in Wrenfield is shaping up. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the fastest next step is usually getting your real tasks in there and bringing one colleague alongside you — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through what you've set up so far and suggest where to go next.

Best,
Chidi
